_about: Settings for the static SEO build (seo_build.part.py, spec docs/janna/SEO-SPEC.md §1). Thresholds decide index/noindex; every decision is recorded per page in site/_seo/pages.json (field 'why'). The admin workspace may later override the thresholds through /api/seo/config; a rebuild applies them.
_note_company_words: The spec's literal rule (≥80 words, or ≥40 words with ≥3 products) indexes only 29 of 2,926 members, because the imported descriptions are WordPress excerpts (1,477 are cut at «…»; only 24 reach 80 words). The spec's own estimate (~885 thin) was counted as «description < 200 characters» (839 today), and 200 Arabic characters ≈ 35 words, so 35/20 reproduces the spec's intent: 1,973 indexable, 953 noindex,follow (before duplicate-description checks). Set 80/40 here to apply the literal rule.
_min_tender_entity_page: An issuing entity with at least this many tenders (but fewer than min_tender_entity) still gets its page /tenders/entity/<slug>/, noindex,follow and outside the hubs and the sitemaps: the agency cards (/agencies/, entity.html#aN) open it. An entity with a single tender opens that tender.
_product_index: Spec §1.3 indexes a product page with ≥min_product_words words OR an image. The image rule alone indexes ~180 pages whose own text is 3–14 words (SEO review, LOW). Raise min_product_words_with_image (e.g. 8) or set product_index_image false to tighten; a rebuild applies it.
_offer_default_days: A store leaflet without an end date counts as current for this many days after it was checked (source_checked), then the offer is listed as ended; never «valid forever».
_static_min_words: site.py pages whose server-rendered <main> has fewer words than this (content rendered by JavaScript only) are written noindex,follow until the template renders content; the home page is never downgraded.
_generated_keys: site.py keys whose canonical page is now generated by seo_build (the hub replaces the former JS page). site.py must not write these to the path in static_paths; it may write the interactive version to app_paths (noindex,follow, canonical = hub).
_shim_keys: Former hash-routed detail templates. The build writes them as tiny noindex,follow pages (<key>.html) that map location.hash to the new clean URL via /_seo/hash/<key>.json. site.py must stop writing these keys.
_signin: The factory sign-in page (signin.part.py): key «signin» → /login/ (+ its English twin /en/login/), noindex, never in a sitemap. It is NOT the owner's /login.html (legacy_live_pages «login», deploy 1), which keeps its URL on the old system.
_canonical_static: site.py page key → the key whose URL is its canonical (true duplicates only). /contractor-leads/ is no duplicate of /leads/ (the contractors' requests only, with its own title) and keeps its own canonical (owner report 2026-11-19).
_gated_static: Pages behind a plan gate (site.py GATES; also read from site.py at build time): noindex,follow because a visitor without the plan (and every crawler) is sent to register.html#partner.
_legacy_live_pages: DEPLOY 1 and DEPLOY 2: pages the owner's old system (Worker mis-egypt → Hostinger PHP, deploy/legacy-live.txt) keeps answering on madeinegyptgate.com. Links to them stay /<key>.html (never rewritten to /<key>/), robots.txt disallows them, and the build never writes them. Deploy 2 keeps them as they are: the new Admin Control Center is /admin/ (panel.part.py, key «admin») and the sign-in page is /login/ (signin.part.py).
_flat_pages: Top-level x.html files that site.py writes on purpose and that must stay files (the janna.html hologram kiosk): never redirected or removed. Any other x.html whose page now has a clean URL gets a 301 and an old copy is deleted from OUT.

zone_match._about: Company → industrial city/zone. Patterns are matched on the location field first; on the description only when the zone's governorate equals the company's governorate.

_admin: The Admin Control Center (deploy 2): key «admin» → /admin/ (static_paths), a standalone page written by panel.part.py through PAGE_WRITERS (noindex,nofollow, never in a sitemap; /admin.html → /admin/ 301 from the build). Team boards: «seo-team» → /seo-team/, «data-desk» → /data-desk/.
